new_results.statement: Order-one mixed Pluecker masses do not control the old absolute two-bank frequency kernel. A strict target family with mixed masses 1/2,1/2 and iid interval leaves has S(zeta)=infinity for every nonzero-sinc zeta. This refutes only that proof interface, not QFORM.

For the sharp r38 mixed frame in the same-sign nonlinear orientation Q=theta H^2+2sqrt(2)HL+2S^2+4LP, arbitrary independent cap-one original laws and every theta give a continuous C0 density with sup norm at most pi/sqrt(2).

partner_application.inequality: At theta=0 in the control family, G=1, row leverages=1/2, gamma=sqrt(2), kappa=2, sigma=0, so ||p||_infinity <=12*4^(-1/3)=7.5595262993...<7.56.

unresolved_implication: Mixed volume must be converted in a phase-aware way; the old absolute kernel cannot do it. Need either a source-separated same-sign-square extraction from the general slope collar or cancellation-preserving two-bank TT*/Fourier pairing before absolute values.
